svg.title: Castle Dragonheart — the royal precinct
svg.desc: A finalized schematic site plan of Castle Dragonheart on Mt Thraltor, with the High Keep, Crown Cathedral, Court Quarter, Royal Ward, main Royal Guard, wizard’s tower, signalling tower and teleportation court. Worldbuilding by Nico; plan and illustration by Ran. The full teleportation circle has an established 15-foot radius and supports multiple squads or troops with supplies; consumable diamonds provide only ordinary 5-foot-radius spell operation. The smaller opening is centred for comparison, not an established equipment position. Occupants of the active circle transfer on activation, and further travellers can enter before closure. Flags link the castle with the auxiliary Royal Guard lookout; beacons carry signals across the mountain range. The accompanying working diagrams explain functional relationships rather than surveyed sightlines. Site-wide scale, bearings, exact footprints, underground routes and the original Orb of Enhancement’s location remain unestablished. The numeral badges are a location key, not troop counts.
